cards.title: Everything that happened, in order
cards.text: 33 on-track passes, 29 pit stops, 3 cars that never finished, 3 virtual safety cars.

cards.title: 25 places changed hands on track before the first lap was done
cards.text: 20 cars into the first corner on cold tyres and full tanks.
bullets: Sainz, Alonso and Ocon gained the most by the end of it, 7 places at best
cards.note: Most of this is the pack sorting itself out. Some of it decides the race.

cards.title: 6 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.
bullets: 6 different drivers gained a place on this lap
cards.note: Early on, with full tanks and the order still settling.

cards.title: Leclerc takes the lead from Russell
cards.text: The lead changed hands 4 times on track.

cards.title: Verstappen starts P20. Where does he finish?
cards.text: 58 laps to make up ground from there.

cards.title: 5 passes on this lap alone
cards.text: Only moves made on track count here, at racing speed.

cards.note: Early on, with full tanks and the order still settling.

cards.title: 5 lap times deleted
cards.text: The white line is the track, and the lap simply stops counting if you leave it.
bullets: Keep doing it and it turns into a penalty

cards.title: 1 penalty handed out
cards.text: Given by the stewards during the race.
bullets: Colapinto: a stop-and-go for starting procedure infringement

cards.title: Gasly: 8 laps within a second of the car ahead
cards.text: The longest unbroken run like it in the race, from lap 2 to lap 9, at racing speed.
bullets: 6 other drivers had a run of five laps or more like it
cards.note: Following closely costs the car downforce and cooks the front tyres, so sitting there is harder than it looks.

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Leclerc was leading when it was called
Norris, Ocon, Gasly and 7 others stopped under it
Lifted on lap 12
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: Hadjar is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 11 of 58, in a Red Bull.
bullets: Running P19 when that lap began
Started P3
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Bottas is out

bullets: Running P18 when that lap began
Started P19

cards.title: Track at 37°C at the start, falling to 34°C at the flag
cards.text: Track temperature changes how much grip the tyres find and how fast they wear. No rain was recorded during the race.

cards.title: One of these three does not see the chequered flag. Who?
cards.text: Nothing on the timing screens says it is coming.
cards.reveal: Alonso, on lap 22 of 58. The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: 29 stops, and the busiest lap saw 7 of them
cards.text: Once one car stops, the cars around it have to answer.
bullets: Busiest single lap was 11, with 7 cars in under the virtual safety car
Shortest time in the pit lane: Leclerc and Norris, 17.6s
Longest: Stroll, 36.7s
cards.note: Pit lane time runs from the entry line to the exit line, stop included.

cards.title: Yellow flags out 4 times
cards.text: Race control waves a yellow for anything on or near the track that should not be there.
bullets: A yellow means slow down and do not overtake in that part of the track
Track sector 13 saw 3 calls, more than anywhere else

cards.title: Verstappen: 7 passes
cards.text: More than anybody else out there, in a Red Bull.
bullets: P20 on the grid, P6 at the flag
cards.note: Only moves made on track count, with the car ahead at racing speed.

cards.title: Stroll stopped 4 times
cards.text: Four stops when most of the field made 1.
bullets: In on laps 11, 26, 34 and 39
One of them under a safety car or VSC

cards.title: Alonso is out
cards.text: His race ends on lap 22 of 58, in an Aston Martin.
bullets: Running P19 when that lap began
Started P17
cards.note: The timing feed records that he stopped, not why.

cards.title: Alonso was running P19 when his race ended on lap 22. Where does he finish if it had not?
cards.text: Nobody can answer this one for certain. You have his own lap times to go on and nothing else.

choices.label: He stays about where he was

cards.reveal: Our read from his own lap times, not a fact. He was lapping 4.35s a lap slower than Russell, who went on to win it. With 36 laps left, "he stays about where he was" is the honest guess, and nobody gets to check.

cards.title: Who has the fastest lap on the board at the flag?
cards.text: It usually lands late, when the car is light and the track has rubber all over it.
cards.reveal: Verstappen on lap 42, 1:22.091, in a Red Bull.

cards.title: Russell hit 321 km/h
cards.text: The fastest car in a straight line is often not the fastest car over a lap.
bullets: Russell did it in a Mercedes
cards.note: Top speed says as much about wing level, and about sitting in somebody's tow, as it does about the engine.

cards.title: Everybody slows down, nobody bunches up
cards.text: Every car is held to a delta time exactly where it is. The gaps freeze instead of vanishing, which is the whole difference from a real safety car.
bullets: Russell was leading when it was called
Bortoleto and Albon stopped under it
Lifted on lap 33
cards.note: A stop under a VSC costs less than one at racing speed, because everybody else is going slowly too. Cheaper, not free: the leader keeps his gap and the queue behind him keeps its shape.

cards.title: 93 blue flags waved
cards.text: That is how often a lapped car was told to let the leaders through.

cards.title: Antonelli had the quickest median racing lap
cards.text: No lap 1, no laps in or out of the pits, nothing behind the safety car or the VSC, and the slow outliers trimmed. It does not always match the result.

cards.title: Verstappen: 1:22.091
cards.text: The quickest anybody went all race, in a Red Bull.
bullets: Set on lap 42 of 58, late on, where they usually land
By then the fuel is nearly gone and the car is at its lightest
It is worth no points: the bonus point for it was dropped after 2024

cards.title: Lawson went the other way: 5 places lost
cards.text: Qualifying promised one thing and the race delivered another.
bullets: P8 on the grid, P13 at the flag
2 stops when most of the field made 1
Qualifying rewards whoever can put one lap together. A race asks for 58 of them

cards.title: Verstappen: P20 on the grid, P6 at the flag
cards.text: 14 places gained.
bullets: 7 on-track passes along the way
3 cars that started ahead of him retired

cards.title: Ocon, Gasly, Russell and 1 other ran one set for 47 laps each
cards.text: The longest anybody stayed out on one set.
bullets: On the hards, lap 11 to lap 57
cards.note: Every lap you stretch is a lap you do not lose in the pit lane. And every lap you stretch is a set of tyres getting slower underneath you.

cards.title: 5 incidents looked at
cards.text: Every one of them logged by race control during the race.
bullets: 4 in no further action and 1 left for after the race

cards.title: Russell wins it
cards.text: P1 Russell · P2 Antonelli · P3 Leclerc.
bullets: After 58 laps, Antonelli crossed the line 2.974s behind

cards.title: How far behind was Antonelli at the flag?
cards.text: 58 laps, 1 hour 23 minutes of racing, and it comes down to this one number.
cards.reveal: 2.974 seconds after 58 laps. A trip down the pit lane took about 19s today, which is 6 times the margin this race was decided by.
